title: Valorization of rambutan peel (Nephelium lappaceum L.) byproducts through pulsed electric field-assisted green extraction of pectin optimized by response surface methodology
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00658A, Paper

Luqman Agung Wicaksono, Ganes Aurora Santoso, Muhammad Alfid Kurnianto, Anugerah Dany Priyanto, Teeradate Kongpichitchoke, Muhammad Rosyid Wardianto
Pulsed electric field–assisted extraction combined with response surface methodology was applied to valorize rambutan peel into high-quality pectin with improved yield, methoxyl content, and functional properties.
